book.title: Letters to the Ghosts of People Within Me
book.pitch: A poetry collection exploring love, loss, resilience, self-discovery, and emotional introspection from growing up and facing life's inevitable changes, to confronting past traumas.

papers.title: An Ensemble-Based Framework for Enhanced Missing Data Imputation
papers.abstract: Proposes a novel ensemble imputation method combining KNN, IterativeImputer, mean, median, and SoftImpute, consistently outperforming individual approaches across missing-data scenarios.

papers.title: Multidisciplinary Research: Societal Implications of Technology
papers.abstract: Explores how technological advancements are transforming society, examining effects on communication, labor markets, governance, and cultural norms.
